automation_sketch.code:
DESKTOP FLOW: AP_Workspace_Launcher
1. Launch Outlook (if not running) -> Wait for 'Inbox' window
2. UI Automation: Click View > Filter > Unread [fallback: Send Keys Alt+V,F,U] -> Verify filter label = 'Unread'
3. Open Document: FilePath = %AP_Tracker_Path% (e.g. SharePoint synced path) ReadOnly=false
4. Excel Action: Activate Worksheet 'October' -> GoTo Cell A1 -> Freeze Panes check
5. Launch Chrome: URL = %Vendor_Portal_Payments_URL% (saved 22-char address from step 7) -> Wait for selector: text='Payments'
6. Arrange Windows: Outlook Left, Excel Center, Chrome Right + Focus Excel!October!A1
7. On Error: Screenshot + Log to %Desktop%\AP_Launcher_Log.txt and stop with message
automation_sketch.description: Power Automate Desktop one-click launcher that reproduces steps 1-8: filters Outlook to unread, opens tracker to October!A1, opens portal Payments URL.

bottlenecks: Trigger in Outlook 0.34 min/item: open inbox + 2 clicks to get unread filter
4 window switches Outlook -> File Explorer -> Excel -> Chrome per 0.7-min run

tasks.name: Process vendor invoice for payment
tasks.summary: Records a vendor invoice in the AP tracker and submits it for payment in the vendor portal. Invoice details are extracted from the PDF attachment, entered into the tracker and payment request with the invoice attached, and the source email is then filed.
inputs: Vendor invoice email with PDF attachment in Outlook inbox
outputs: Updated AP tracker with invoice details
Submitted payment request with supporting invoice in vendor portal
Filed invoice email in Processed folder
decision_points: Determine the correct due date to record for the invoice
Determine the appropriate GL code to assign to the invoice
reasons: 32 values copied by hand from one application to another

assumptions: Due date in Excel column D (steps 10, 17) source is unknown - assumed to require human lookup or PO-terms rule until confirmed, not auto-derived
GL code in Excel column E (step 11) source is unknown - assumed to require human judgement or chart-of-accounts lookup until confirmed
Vendor Portal has no confirmed API (status unknown) - assumed no usable API so RPA/browser automation is needed until vendor or IT confirms
AP Tracker.xlsx is stored in SharePoint or OneDrive so Microsoft Graph Excel API / Excel Online connector can write it without file-lock conflicts
Invoice PDF attachments are accessible via Graph attachment bytes and are readable by Azure Document Intelligence invoice model with human review for low-confidence fields
No additional PO matching, approval, or duplicate-invoice check beyond the 23 recorded steps is required before submit

automation_sketch.code:
TRIGGER: Power Automate Cloud Flow - When a new email arrives in shared AP inbox (from vendor / subject contains Invoice) including attachments
ACTION 1: Get attachment content (Microsoft Graph mail API) - save INV-#.pdf to SharePoint /AP Invoices/{invoiceReceivedDate}_{sender}/
ACTION 2: Call Azure Document Intelligence invoice model (prebuilt-invoice) on PDF bytes -> returns invoiceNumber, vendorName, invoiceTotal, invoiceDate, dueDate_candidate + confidence
ACTION 3: Condition - if confidence < 0.85 OR duplicate invoiceNumber exists in AP Tracker.xlsx -> route to manual review (Teams Adaptive Card / Outlook flag), stop auto-post
ACTION 4: Excel Online (Business) - Add a row into AP Tracker.xlsx table: Column A = invoiceNumber, Column B = vendorName, Column C = invoiceTotal, Column D = dueDate (from model OR Net-30 rule pending confirmation), Column E = blank for GL review
ACTION 5: If Vendor Portal accessible: start Desktop flow / Playwright with parameters (vendorName, invoiceNumber, amount, dueDate, SharePoint file path) to create payment request - no retyping
ACTION 6: Graph moveMessage - move source email to Processed folder, set categories = Posted, link SharePoint file + tracker row ID in email body
automation_sketch.description: Power Automate cloud flow that implements Recommendation 1: Outlook trigger to Document Intelligence extraction to Excel write, with confidence gate and handoff to portal RPA. Uses only customer-owned M365 + Azure.

bottlenecks: Write in Chrome Vendor Portal (steps 14-21): 0.8 min per item - bottleneck, retypes vendor/invoice/due date already in PDF/tracker plus attach dialog and double Submit in run 6
Manual extraction Acrobat Reader to Excel (steps 3-9): 24 hand copies Acrobat Reader->Excel, scroll to find total (step 7) plus zoom rework in Run 4
Motion waste: 10 window switches and 6 navigations per item, 80 switches total across Outlook/Acrobat/Excel/Chrome

Judgement inputs steps 10-11 (due date 10 chars typed, GL code 4 chars typed) with unknown rules - blocks straight-through processing and forces corrections (vendor/amount/invoice/due date each rewritten 8 times)
quick_wins: Pin Outlook/Excel/Portal side-by-side and use Outlook Quick Steps + Excel Table with GL-code dropdown and due-date = invoice-date+30 formula as interim until flow live
Add duplicate check in AP Tracker.xlsx (COUNTIF on column A invoice number) and data validation on Amount to prevent double-pay from double Submit clicks
Create Outlook rule to auto-save invoice PDFs to SharePoint /AP Invoices/ and keep email filing to Processed (steps 22-23) as a one-click Quick Step

recommendations.how: Build one Power Automate cloud flow triggered by new vendor invoice email in Outlook. Get the PDF bytes via Microsoft Graph mail API, call Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice model to return invoiceNumber, vendorName, and total due with confidence. If confidence is high and invoiceNumber is not already in AP Tracker.xlsx, add a row via Excel Online connector (A=invoiceNumber, B=vendor, C=amount) and save the PDF to SharePoint for the later attach step.
recommendations.title: Auto-extract invoice PDF and populate AP tracker
recommendations.why: ECRS eliminate + combine: removes 24 hand copies Acrobat Reader->Excel and scroll/zoom rework (Run 4). Applies poka-yoke by capturing once from AI instead of copy-paste, and attacks 76% retyping time and NVA 1.56 min/item.

recommendations.how: Ask vendor/IT in writing if Vendor Portal has a supported API; until confirmed use Power Automate Desktop (or Playwright Python) subflow. Pass vendorName, invoiceNumber, amount, dueDate and SharePoint PDF path as parameters, open New Payment Request, fill all fields from variables, upload file by path instead of file-dialog clicks, submit once and scrape confirmation number back to Excel. Add pre-check that Submit is disabled after first click.
recommendations.title: Fill vendor portal payment request without retyping - API first, RPA fallback
recommendations.why: Theory of Constraints: fixes the 0.8 min/item bottleneck. ECRS eliminate retyping of 3 proven-duplicate values (Vendor, Invoice number, Due date) plus Amount from column C, and prevents defects seen as 8 corrections per field and double Submit in run 6.

recommendations.how: Stop treating Excel as an in-between copy buffer. Keep AP Tracker.xlsx only as the audit record written by the flow. Replace free typing of due date and GL code with rules: e.g., dueDate = invoiceDate + payment terms lookup by vendor, GL code = vendor-default dropdown with override. Add Excel data validation and Power BI duplicate/amount dashboard for review.
recommendations.title: Standardize due date and GL code, keep tracker as auto-written record
recommendations.why: ECRS simplify and rearrange: turns unknown free typing (10-char due date, 4-char GL) into lookups/dropdowns, enables batch validation before submit, and eliminates copying column C only to copy it out again.

recommendations.how: Replace manual Move menu steps with an Outlook inbox rule or final Graph moveMessage action in the same flow: after tracker row + portal confirmation succeed, move the source email to Processed folder and tag category Posted with link to tracker row and portal request ID.
recommendations.title: Auto-file processed invoice email
recommendations.why: ECRS automate leftover BVA work: removes 2 navigation steps per item and guarantees filing even if portal step is retried, with zero new tooling.

risks: AI extraction errors on scanned/low-quality PDFs or new layouts causing wrong vendor/amount -> require confidence threshold + human review and duplicate invoiceNumber check to avoid double payment
Portal UI changes breaking Power Automate Desktop/Playwright selectors -> use stable selectors, re-login handling, and monitor failure rate; prefer vendor API if provided
Excel file locks or concurrent edits if AP Tracker.xlsx stays on desktop -> must move to SharePoint/OneDrive Table and use Graph/connector writes only
Graph/SharePoint permissions and retention: mail read/write, mailbox move, and invoice PII storage need least-privilege consent and audit logging

tasks.name: Send weekly AP summary email
tasks.summary: Distributes the weekly accounts payable status to the AP manager for review. The summary sheet in the tracker workbook is refreshed and copied into a new email, which is sent with the tracker spreadsheet attached.
outputs: Weekly AP summary email with tracker attachment sent
decision_points: Verify the refreshed summary data is complete and accurate before sharing
Confirm the correct recipient, subject, message content, and attachment before sending
reasons: 1 values copied by hand from one application to another

assumptions: AP Tracker.xlsx can be stored in SharePoint / OneDrive for Business so Power Automate Excel Online (Business) and Graph can access it unattended
Weekly recipient (To - 24 chars typed) is a fixed AP manager / distribution list and does not require judgement each week - to be confirmed
Subject (38 chars typed) follows a fixed rule e.g. Weekly AP Summary + week-ending date - to be confirmed
Message body (180 chars typed) is a standard template plus dynamic summary figures from Excel - to be confirmed, no free-form commentary requiring judgement
Excel data connections can refresh unattended via Power Query / Office Scripts without manual credentials or on-prem gateway

automation_sketch.code:
TRIGGER: Recurrence - Frequency: Week, Interval: 1, On: Friday, At: 08:00 UTC (Run a cloud flow on a schedule) ACTION 1: Excel Online (Business) - Get file metadata - Library: Shared Documents, File: /AP/AP Tracker.xlsx ACTION 2: Office Scripts - Run script 'GetSummaryTableAsHTML' on AP Tracker.xlsx, Worksheet: 'Summary' (script reads UsedRange/Table, returns htmlTable + totalDue + overdueCount + weekEnding) ACTION 3: Outlook - Send an email (V2) - To: [AP-Manager-DL - confirm address], Subject: concat('Weekly AP Summary - w/e ', outputs('Run_script')?['body/weekEnding']), Body:

Hi [Name],

Weekly AP status for w/e @{weekEnding}:

@{htmlTable}

Total due: @{totalDue}, Overdue: @{overdueCount}

Full tracker attached.

, Attachments: Name: AP Tracker.xlsx, ContentBytes: @{body('Get_file_content')} - Set Importance: Normal, Is HTML: Yes ACTION 4 (control): SharePoint - Create item in 'AP Sends Log' with timestamp, recipient, subject, status
automation_sketch.description: Scheduled Power Automate cloud flow that replaces steps 1-10: refreshes/reads the Summary sheet via Office Script and sends templated Outlook email with tracker attached.

bottlenecks: Write in Outlook 1.42 min/item (steps 4-10): 242 chars typed by hand for To, Subject, Message body
Transportation waste: 1 copy-paste Excel -> Outlook Message body per run plus manual Attach File search
Refresh + navigation: open workbook, Refresh All connections, select/copy summary (steps 1-3) with wait and window switches
quick_wins: Create Outlook template / Quick Parts for To + Subject 'Weekly AP Summary - w/e YYYY-MM-DD' + body skeleton to eliminate 242 chars retyping
Add AP manager as contact group / distribution list to prevent 24-char To typo
Pin AP Tracker.xlsx to Excel Recent + Outlook Attach File Recent and save email as Draft template with attachment placeholder

recommendations.how: Move AP Tracker.xlsx to SharePoint. Build one Power Automate scheduled cloud flow for Friday 08:00. Flow runs Office Script GetSummaryTableAsHTML on Summary sheet, then uses Office 365 Outlook Send an email (V2) with fixed To, calculated Subject with week-ending date, HTML body embedding the summary table, and File Content of AP Tracker.xlsx as attachment.
recommendations.title: Replace manual send with scheduled Power Automate cloud flow
recommendations.why: Theory of Constraints: fixes bottleneck Write in Outlook 1.42 min. ECRS Automate after Simplify. Evidence: 72% time moving/re-typing, PCE 23%, documented Graph Excel + mail APIs and Excel Online connector.

recommendations.how: Lock the three typed fields to rules: To = fixed AP-manager DL, Subject = 'Weekly AP Summary - w/e ' + date, Body = 4-line template with placeholders for week-ending, total payable, overdue count pasted from Summary sheet. Store template in the flow and as Outlook template backup. Get AP manager sign-off once.
recommendations.title: Standardize To, Subject and Body to template with dates/figures
recommendations.why: ECRS Simplify + poka-yoke: turns free typing into rules. Evidence: Lean finding to turn To, Subject, Message body into rules/lookups; 242 chars typed by hand is error-prone.

recommendations.how: Add Office Script 'GetSummaryTableAsHTML' that refreshes Power Query tables, waits for refresh, reads Summary UsedRange/Table, validates non-empty totals, and returns HTML + JSON metrics. Call it from the cloud flow instead of manual Refresh All + Select/Copy. Log refresh errors to SharePoint list.
recommendations.title: Automate Refresh All and summary extract with Office Script
recommendations.why: Poka-yoke + ECRS Combine: makes stale-data send impossible. Evidence: step 2 manual refresh can be skipped or fail silently; copy-paste Excel->Outlook x1.

risks: Wrong recipient if To typed from memory - mitigate with fixed DL and flow audit log
Sending stale figures if Refresh All fails or file is locked open - mitigate with script validation + alert on failure
Attaching wrong version / sending sensitive payables externally - mitigate with SharePoint single source, Graph least-privilege, DLP
Excel connections requiring manual login or on-prem gateway will block unattended refresh - confirm auth before go-live
